name: Tutan Kha-boom
review:
A party in the tomb, on a 5x3 grid with 99 ways. Tutan Kha-boom himself is the explosive wild, and the Bottoms Up feature adds more on top.

It's a simple game with a silly sense of humour. Medium volatility, 5,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.17%, below average, so it's one to try in demo before playing for real money.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
